title: Naturality of the shifted monoidal strength
statement: For the rational projective-line shifted strength, an arbitrary arrow in the second tensor factor may be moved outside the strength, with any subsequent map transported by the twist. The equality is the displayed theorem `secondTraceStrength_naturality`, for arbitrary objects Q, R, Z and arrows z, q, and τ.

proof.text: Expand the conjugated strength into associators, the native braiding, the monoidal tensorator and tensorShiftIso. Naturality of associators, braiding and the tensorator moves z through the word; tensorShiftIso naturality identifies the two shifted endpoints. Reassociate the resulting composite to obtain the displayed equality for arbitrary q and τ.

theorem secondTraceStrength_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K V : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y))
    (Q R Z : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (z : (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj V ⟶ Q)
    (q : ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K) ⊗ Q ⟶ R)
    (τ : (twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj R ⟶ Z) :
    (secondTraceStrength (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) K V).hom ≫
        (twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).map
          ((secondTraceTensorIso (coefficient l c).X Y K V).inv ≫
            ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K ◁ z) ≫ q) ≫ τ =
      (((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K)) ◁ z) ≫
        secondTraceStrengthTail (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) K Q ≫
        (twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).map q ≫ τ
